source.why: Use authored child anatomy, fitted joint landmarks and skinning instead of disconnected primitives.

nose_shape.why: User requested a subtly wider, less protruding nose for Kai. Keep the change localized to his nose rather than applying a whole-face ancestry morph.

hair.why: Authored fitted hairstyles with 2K strand textures and alpha-cut layered cards: short02 for Kai, elvs_hazel_hair for Camille, punkduck_alpha7_curly2 for Corinne. Procedural tube hair removed.

clothing.why: Separate loose fabric patterns, pinned at neckline or waistband, collision-draped over plain child bodies. Baked folds, thick fabric edges and rolled hems; skinned for game animation.

covered_skin.why: Omit only skin well inside the shirt, leaving overlap inside the open collar, hem and cuffs. This prevents independently skinned armpit tissue from poking through the cloth during walking.

pouch.why: A complete fitted neck loop, closed under the throat by a buckle and tongue, carries a gathered leather bag against the right side. The loop is sampled from the actual neck cross-section, rather than an arc floating above the back.

developmental_shape.why: Age-specific source shapes and authored shoulder/arm measurement morphs; skin sections fitted to height-scaled NCHS child references. No arbitrary width fields. Accepted face and hair geometry held fixed.

art_direction.why: User requested simpler sloping shoulders and shorter, less lanky arms with smaller hands. Population lengths remain a reference, not the visual target.
